purpose: Account for the phase 1 renderer's CPU cost before implementing stereo command replay.

gpu_spot_sample.method: nvidia-smi; one sample, not an average or GPU execution-time measurement

external_render_thread_sample.method: 250 Hz wall-clock samples of the render thread; brief suspension to copy the stack, followed by off-thread unwinding. Stack bytes stayed in memory. These are not CPU-only samples.

background_call_path_followup.interpretation: The renderer repeatedly polls the shared job queue, executes available jobs and checks worker completion. Inclusive time includes useful jobs and synchronization; it is not all wasted waiting.
background_call_path_followup.conditions: After the stationary capture; headset activity and view were not controlled. Not a matched performance comparison.

background_cpu_affinity_trial.method: Routine ten-second engine timing windows; 22 seconds per condition, discarding the first mixed window. Headset inactive; not comparable with the stationary headset baseline.
background_cpu_affinity_trial.interpretation: No useful improvement observed from restricting the process to one CPU chiplet.

limits: Local CPU/GPU/runtime only; no RTX 5080 reporter validation or confirmed fix for issue 20.
Application stereo-pair throughput is not headset delivery or compositor reprojection rate.
Per-eye GetThreadTimes has coarse accounting ticks; averages over the capture are useful, per-frame attribution is not precise.
Private game symbols are unavailable; job-path attribution is inferred from call paths and inspected loop behavior.
Wall-clock stack samples include blocked and running states, and inclusive paths overlap.
SteamVR's roughly 20 ms GPU timing span is not evidence of 20 ms active GPU execution; it can include queue starvation and scheduling gaps.
Elevated Windows CPU tracing was unavailable; a bounded user-process sampler was used instead.
A later in-headset profile request timed out while the headset was inactive; its controls were restored, and it supplied no benchmark data.
No replay implementation, new runtime installation or performance gain is established by these measurements.
